value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for 1-year-olds (walking) to 3 years with a parent/caregiver - their site says, with fall slots Sept 14-Nov 1 including Mondays 9:30, Tuesdays 10:15, and Saturdays 9:15. I could not pin down the price or registration date. I'll keep watching and text you when those post.
